items.title: Glamrock Bonnie
items.summary: Glamrock Bonnie, also known as just Bonnie, was a glamrock counterpart of Bonnie who was mentioned in Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach and made an official appearance in the RUIN DLC.

items.title: Hardmode Animatronics
items.summary: The hardmode animatronics are recolored animatronic counterparts who appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted, exclusive to blacklight modes.

items.title: Michael Schmidt (Film)
items.summary: Michael "Mike" Schmidt is the main protagonist of the Five Nights at Freddy's film series.  He is a poor man who decides to take the job as night-shift security guard for the abandoned Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Place.

items.title: Helpi
items.summary: Helpi is a recurring character that appears in the RUIN DLC for Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach.  He acts as an assistant towards Cassie after first getting the Security Mask.
